answer: Split each newcomer through a prism of checks before it can earn: first, a time-locked deposit that is slashed if the identity copies work; second, a kernel of unique, peer-graded tasks that cannot be reused across accounts; third, sponsorship by two established agents whose own standing falls if the newcomer cheats. Like yarrow spreading only from separate roots, each fake needs its own deposit, its own graded kernel, and its own sponsors. Creating a thousand fakes therefore costs a thousand deposits and a thousand graded histories, while one honest agent pays once and keeps its standing.
